title: MEV Front-Running on Claim Transactions
description: Competitive claiming with no slippage protection in a fixed-rate exchange environment. MEV bots can observe pending claim transactions and front-run to capture yield before regular users.
impact: MEV bots may claim yield before regular users. However, this represents fair competition rather than value extraction - all participants pay the same rate and anyone can claim available yield.
attackPath: User submits claim transaction to mempool
Bot submits higher gas transaction to claim first
User's transaction claims remaining yield or fails
Bot captures yield at fair market rate
recommendation: Consider implementing a commit-reveal scheme or private mempool integration for claim transactions. Alternatively, document that claiming is competitive and first-come-first-served.
